BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Bernabeu 
 That was the biggest chance of the night so far and it came for Leipzig. 
 Romulo with a cracking left-footed volley has forced Courtois to make a brilliant save.

 'Take a moment to praise Martin Odegaard's pass' published at 20:30 BST 20:30 BST 
 Bayern Munich 0-1 Arsenal 
 Matt Upson 
Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Take a moment to praise Martin Odegaard's pass. It's a brilliant left footed ball, it really is. He sees the space, and whips it from centre field. Eze's onto it, and it's a quality finish from his left foot.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Aston Villa 1-0 Viking 
 Ross Barkley has been directly involved in six goals in his last three starts across all competitions (four goals, two assists).
 He has scored in three consecutive starts for the first time since October 2020 (one for Chelsea, two for Aston Villa).

 Real Betis 0-0 Feyenoord 
 Republic of Ireland international Troy Parrott is in action for Real Betis against Feyenoord tonight.
 The former Tottenham and AZ Alkmaar man has helped the La Liga side record back-to-back wins in the Champions League this season.

 Sitter.
